business_profile.competitive_position: BD INTERIOR sits at the very top of the Bangladeshi interior market — ISO certification, a blue-chip corporate roster, and 15+ years of brand equity that most competitors can't match. Their vulnerability isn't quality or reputation; it's lead capture and follow-up. A firm this established gets constant inbound interest, but without an automated intake + qualification + booking flow, every enquiry that hits a busy phone line or lands after hours is at risk. Smaller, hungrier competitors with online booking and instant WhatsApp responses are quietly capturing the overflow — especially younger, tech-comfortable homeowners who won't call.
business_profile.opportunity_size: With 700+ projects and premium pricing (BDT 500K+), BD INTERIOR likely turns over BDT 350M+ in project value. If phone-only intake and zero automated follow-up lose even 5% of inbound enquiries, that's BDT 17.5M+ in missed project value per year. An AI agent that answers every enquiry instantly, qualifies budget/project type, follows up on every cost-calculator submission, and books consultations would directly recover this leakage — plus reactivate a 550+ client base for referrals and repeat/renovation work.
business_profile.how_the_agent_helps:
1. AI enquiry agent on website + WhatsApp that replies to every prospect within seconds, qualifies project type (home/office/restaurant), budget range, and timeline, and books a design consultation — 24/7, no missed leads.
2. Cost-calculator follow-up agent: every visitor who uses the 'Calculate Interior Cost' widget gets an instant personalized follow-up with next steps and a consultation booking link.
3. Past-client reactivation agent that checks in with the 550+ historical clients, asks for referrals, and surfaces renovation/repeat opportunities.
4. Corporate enquiry SLA tracker that ensures institutional leads (BRAC, BAT, etc.) get a response within a guaranteed window.
business_profile.demo_scenario: A homeowner in Gulshan uses BD INTERIOR's 'Calculate Interior Cost' widget at 11pm for a 2,200 SFT apartment. Within 10 seconds the AI agent replies: 'Thanks! For a 2,200 SFT home, most of our clients invest BDT 18–28 lakh depending on finishes. I can have a designer show you 3D concepts for your layout — here are 3 consultation slots this week.' The homeowner books Thursday 4pm. The next morning the BD INTERIOR team gets a structured brief: name, location, SFT, budget range, consultation time — before making a single call. Meanwhile the agent has also flagged 2 past clients in the same area who might want a renovation quote.
